classification.difficultyReason: A context hypotenuse problem. The diagram shows the right triangle and its marker, so it is a single application of Pythagoras with rounding. It is slightly easier than the gate diagonal.

content.prompt:
A ramp leads up to a loading platform 1.1 m high.
The bottom of the ramp is 2.6 m from the platform along the ground.
Calculate the length of the ramp correct to 1 decimal place.

answer.worked:
The ramp is the hypotenuse of a right-angled triangle.
$$\begin{align*}a^2+b^2&=h^2\\2.6^2+1.1^2&=h^2\\7.97&=h^2\\\sqrt{7.97}&=h\\h&\approx2.8\text{ m}\end{align*}$$
The ramp is $2.8\text{ m}$ long, correct to 1 decimal place.
